_note: Every elemental reaction, read by genshin-reactions.js (the Lobby wheel + /genshin-impact/reactions). Facts: Genshin Impact Wiki (Fandom, CC BY-SA) + the in-game tutorials, checked Oct 26 2026 for 7.1; research notes in docs/genshin-reactions-research.md. pair = the two elements that trigger it on the wheel (with = the partners for Swirl / Crystallize); on = a follow-up that needs another reaction first; swap = the reaction it replaces when one of `by` is in the party; coef = Base Reaction Coefficient x the level multiplier; dmg = which EM formula (trans 16, lunar 6, add 5, amp 2.78).

families.name: Amplifying
families.line: Multiply the hit that triggers them, so they scale with that hit and crit with it.

families.name: Transformative
families.line: Deal their own damage from your level and Elemental Mastery. They can't crit and ignore enemy DEF.

families.name: Catalyze
families.line: Quicken sets the enemy up; Aggravate and Spread add flat damage to the next hit.

families.name: Control & shields
families.line: No damage of their own: they freeze enemies or drop shields.

families.name: Lunar
families.line: Nod-Krai. Three Hydro reactions swapped for stronger ones when a Moon Wheel user or Columbina is in the party.

families.name: Stellar Glimmer
families.line: Snezhnaya. Two Cryo reactions swapped for stronger ones when a Stellar Linchpin user or the Cryo Traveler is in the party.

reactions.name: Vaporize
reactions.desc: Hydro and Pyro boil off and the hit that triggers it is multiplied: 2× when Hydro hits a Pyro enemy, 1.5× the other way round.
reactions.tip: The 1.5× side uses up less of the aura, so it can trigger again sooner.

reactions.name: Melt
reactions.desc: Pyro and Cryo cancel out and the hit that triggers it is multiplied: 2× when Pyro hits a Cryo enemy, 1.5× the other way round.
reactions.tip: Frozen enemies melt too: Pyro on a Frozen target triggers Melt.

reactions.name: Overloaded
reactions.desc: A Pyro explosion that hits every enemy around the target and knocks them back.
reactions.tip: Great on small fry, a pain when it blasts them out of your attacks.

reactions.name: Superconduct
reactions.desc: Area Cryo damage that cuts enemies' Physical RES by 40% for 12 seconds.
reactions.tip: Built for Physical teams: the shred is the point, not the damage.

reactions.name: Electro-Charged
reactions.desc: Both elements stay on the enemy, which takes Electro damage every second until one runs out. Each tick also arcs to one wet enemy nearby.
reactions.tip: Because both auras stay on, a third element can trigger two reactions at once.

reactions.name: Frozen
reactions.desc: Locks the enemy in ice. Keep putting Hydro and Cryo on to keep it frozen; a heavy hit breaks it with Shatter.
reactions.tip: Bosses can't be frozen, so Freeze teams shine in the Abyss's smaller rooms.

reactions.name: Swirl
reactions.desc: Anemo picks up Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo and spreads it to every enemy around, dealing that element's damage.
reactions.tip: The spread element can react again: a Pyro Swirl onto wet enemies Vaporizes.

reactions.name: Crystallize
reactions.desc: Geo knocks a shard of the other element loose. Pick it up for a shield that blocks that element best.
reactions.tip: The shard has to be picked up: walk over it or it fades.

reactions.name: Bloom
reactions.desc: Spawns a Dendro Core that bursts after a few seconds for AoE Dendro damage, and nicks you too.
reactions.tip: Only 5 cores fit on the field: a sixth makes the oldest burst at once.

reactions.name: Burning
reactions.desc: Sets the enemy alight: Pyro damage over time to it and anything standing in the fire, which keeps putting Pyro back on.
reactions.tip: Ticks four times a second, which is how it keeps re-applying Pyro for Vaporize or Melt.

reactions.name: Quicken
reactions.desc: Leaves the enemy Quickened. Nothing happens yet: the next Electro hit triggers Aggravate, the next Dendro hit Spread.
reactions.tip: Quicken itself deals no damage. The payoff is every hit after it.

reactions.name: Aggravate
reactions.desc: An Electro hit on a Quickened enemy gets flat damage added before crit, scaling with level and Elemental Mastery.
reactions.tip: The bonus is added before crit, so it crits with the hit.

reactions.name: Spread
reactions.desc: A Dendro hit on a Quickened enemy gets flat damage added before crit, scaling with level and Elemental Mastery.
reactions.tip: A little stronger than Aggravate: 1.25 against 1.15.

reactions.name: Hyperbloom
reactions.desc: Electro hits a Dendro Core: it turns into a homing shot that slams one enemy.
reactions.tip: The shots seek enemies, never you: the safe way to play Bloom.

reactions.name: Burgeon
reactions.desc: Pyro hits a Dendro Core: it explodes in a wider blast.
reactions.tip: The blast can hurt your own character, like Bloom.

reactions.name: Shatter
reactions.desc: Something heavy (a claymore, a plunge, Geo) breaks a Frozen enemy for Physical damage.
reactions.tip: Breaking the ice ends the freeze, so Freeze teams usually avoid it.

reactions.name: Lunar-Charged
reactions.desc: A thundercloud forms and strikes every enemy carrying both Electro and Hydro nearby with Electro damage, every 2 seconds. The damage blends everyone who put an element on, and it can crit.
reactions.tip: Only one cloud at a time. Trigger it again and its 6 s timer starts over.

reactions.name: Lunar-Bloom
reactions.desc: Bloom plus Verdant Dew: the Dendro Cores still appear, and the party collects Dew. The reaction deals no damage by itself; characters' talents deal Lunar-Bloom damage, many by spending the Dew.
reactions.tip: Verdant Dew never runs out: it stays through team swaps, teleports, the daily reset and closing the game.

reactions.name: Lunar-Crystallize
reactions.desc: Three Moondrifts form around the enemy. Every third Lunar-Crystallize makes them resonate: Moondrift Harmony fires a homing shot of Geo damage that blends everyone who put an element on, and it can crit.
reactions.tip: Moondrifts count as Geo constructs: with two Geo characters, Enduring Rock's +15% DMG turns on even with no shield.

reactions.name: Stellar-Conduct
reactions.desc: A Starlight Prism appears and turns the area into a Polestar Field for 7 seconds: Cryo and Electro DMG up, enemies' Physical RES down 40%. Every 4 s the field counts your Cryo and Electro hits and grows stronger. The damage itself comes from characters' talents.
reactions.tip: In Snezhnaya's open world the field also keeps you warm and powers up Prime Ice constructs and firearms.

reactions.name: Stellar Swirl
reactions.desc: A hit of Anemo damage, then a Stellar Vortex that explodes in AoE Cryo. Trigger it three times and the Vortex grows to a bigger, stronger Lv. 2; three more set it off at once.
reactions.tip: When a Vortex explodes, your next jump within 5 s goes higher.
